disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provisions of the Wholesale Drug Distributor Licensing Act or rules and regulations adopted under the act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A wholesale drug distributor license may be denied, refused renewal, suspended, limited, or revoked by the department when the department finds that the applicant or licensee has violated any provisions of the Wholesale Drug Distributor Licensing Act or of the rules and regulations adopted and promulgated under the act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any acts or offenses set forth in sections 38-178, 38-179, or 71-7459.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or has committed any acts or offenses set forth in section 38-178, 38-179, or 71-7459

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false or fraudulent records or making false or fraudulent statements to the department or federal officials.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing the department, any of its representatives, or any federal official with false or fraudulent records or making false or fraudulent statements regarding any matter under the act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a prescription drug by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation, or engaging in misrepresentation or fraud in distribution.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a prescription drug by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation or engaging in misrepresentation or fraud in the distribution of a prescription drug

disciplinary_grounds.description: Manufacture, repackaging, sale, transfer, delivery, holding, or offering for sale of any adulterated, misbranded, counterfeit, or otherwise unfit prescription drug.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the manufacture, repackaging, sale, transfer, delivery, holding, or offering for sale of any prescription drug that is adulterated, misbranded, counterfeit, suspected of being counterfeit, or otherwise rendered unfit for distribution

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adulteration, misbranding, or counterfeiting of any prescription drug.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the adulteration, misbranding, or counterfeiting of any prescription drug

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receipt of any adulterated, misbranded, stolen, fraudulently obtained, counterfeit, or suspected counterfeit prescription drug and delivery or proffered delivery for pay or otherwise.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The receipt of any prescription drug that is adulterated, misbranded, stolen, obtained by fraud or deceit, counterfeit, or suspected of being counterfeit, and the delivery or proffered delivery of such drug for pay or otherwise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Alteration, mutilation, destruction, obliteration, or removal of labeling of a prescription drug resulting in misbranding.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The alteration, mutilation, destruction, obliteration, or removal of the whole or any part of the labeling of a prescription drug or the commission of any other act with respect to a prescription drug that results in the prescription drug being misbranded

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying a pedigree or selling/distributing a counterfeit prescription drug that could cause serious adverse health consequences or death.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a wholesale drug distributor has falsified a pedigree or has sold, distributed, transferred, manufactured, repackaged, handled, or held a counterfeit prescription drug intended for human use and such drug could cause serious, adverse health consequences or death

bonding_required.quote: The application shall be accompanied by the fee established by the department under section 71-7450 and proof of bond or other security required under section 71-7452

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each wholesale drug distributor doing business in this state shall be inspected by the department or a nationally recognized accreditation program that is approved by the board and that is acting on behalf of the department prior to the issuance of an initial or renewal license

definition_quote.value: Wholesale drug distribution means the distribution of prescription drugs to a person other than a consumer or patient.
definition_quote.quote: Wholesale drug distribution means the distribution of prescription drugs to a person other than a consumer or patient.

value: distribution of prescription drugs to persons other than consumers or patients
restocking of prescription drugs for emergency medical services (in certain circumstances)
general stocking of prescription drugs for emergency medical services
methods_authorized.quote: Wholesale drug distribution means the distribution of prescription drugs to a person other than a consumer or patient.

drug_authority.value: Wholesale drug distributors may distribute prescription drugs; they must furnish prescription drugs only to persons licensed by the department and verify such licensure before furnishing drugs to persons not known to them.
drug_authority.quote: A manufacturer or wholesale drug distributor shall furnish prescription drugs only to persons licensed by the department and shall verify such licensure before furnishing prescription drugs to a person not known to the manufacturer or wholesale drug distributor.

license_per_facility_required.quote: A separate license shall be obtained for each such facility

surety_bond_required.quote: The application shall be accompanied by the fee established by the department under section 71-7450 and proof of bond or other security required under section 71-7452

recordkeeping_retention_period_years.quote: Each paper or electronic pedigree shall be maintained by the purchaser and the wholesale drug distributor for three years from the date of sale or transfer

value: Intracompany sales between divisions, subsidiaries, parent companies, or affiliated companies under common ownership or control
Sale, purchase, or trade by a 501(c)(3) charitable organization, state, political subdivision, or governmental agency to a nonprofit affiliate
Sale, purchase, or trade among hospitals or health care entities under common ownership or control
Sale, purchase, or trade for emergency medical reasons or for practitioner routine office procedures (not exceeding 5% of sales)
Dispensing of a prescription drug pursuant to a prescription
Distribution of drug samples by manufacturer or wholesale drug distributor representatives
Sale, purchase, or trade of blood and blood components intended for transfusion
Delivery by a common carrier solely in the usual course of transporting drugs (without storing, warehousing, or taking legal ownership)
Restocking of prescription drugs by a hospital for an emergency medical service where drugs were used for the patient prior to or during transportation
excluded_transaction_types.quote: Wholesale drug distribution does not include: (a) Intracompany sales of prescription drugs... (b) The sale, purchase, or trade of or an offer to sell, purchase, or trade a prescription drug by a charitable organization... (c) The sale, purchase, or trade of or an offer to sell, purchase, or trade a prescription drug among hospitals or other health care entities operating under common ownership or common control... (d) The sale, purchase, or trade of or an offer to sell, purchase, or trade a prescription drug for emergency medical reasons... (e) The sale, purchase, or trade of, an offer to sell, purchase, or trade, or the dispensing of a prescription drug pursuant to a prescription... (f) The distribution of drug samples by representatives of a manufacturer or of a wholesale drug distributor... (g) The sale, purchase, or trade of blood and blood components intended for transfusion... (h) The delivery of or the offer to deliver a prescription drug by a common carrier solely in the usual course of business... (i) The restocking of prescription drugs by a hospital for an emergency medical service

responsible_persons_list_required.quote: The names and addresses of the owner and manager of the applicant's wholesale drug distribution facilities, a designated representative at each such facility, and all managerial employees at each such facility
